1.3.2.4-r1.burton_quote: for it much differs from that which commonly befalls men and other women, as having one only cause proper to women alone

1.3.2.4-r2.burton_quote: with a kind of still dotage and grief of some part or other, head, heart, breasts, sides, back, belly, &c.
1.3.2.4-r2.translation: The skin is sometimes squalid, rough and wrinkled, especially at the elbows, knees and finger joints; the region about the heart often burns and throbs with great heat, and when the vapour is stirred up and flies upward, the heart palpitates or is oppressed, the spirit faints, etc.

1.3.2.4-r3.burton_quote: dejection of mind, much discontent, preposterous judgement. They are apt to loathe, dislike, disdain, to be weary of every object, &c., each thing almost is tedious to them, they pine away, void of counsel, apt to weep, and tremble, timorous, fearful, sad, and out of all hope of better fortunes. They take delight in nothing for the time, but love to be alone and solitary
